newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oil companies begin seismic work in Barent Sea.
newsitem.headline: Oil companies begin seismic work in Barent Sea.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday a seismic survey programme had begun on the Finnmark East area of the Barents Sea.

The area was only recently opened to seismic investigation and is not covered by any formal production licence. Companies will be able to apply for licences when the seismic work is completed, Statoil, which is operator for the project, said.
"We're initially collecting two-dimensional seismic over the whole 5,041 square kilometre area," Jan Aage Greger, project manager, told the company's Status Weekly newsletter.
"These data will allow us to select a limited area for three-dimensional surveying, which is on next summer's programme."

Participants in Finnmark East are Statoil as operator with 30 percent, the state's direct financial interest 20 percent, Saga Petroleum with 20 percent and Norsk Hydro and Norsk Agip with 15 percent each.
